items.title: AI's next big bottleneck isn't infrastructure. It's regulatory red tape.
items.summary: Resistance to data center development and AI regulation is taking center stage in politics ahead of the midterm elections. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley joins Market Domination's Josh Lipton to break down the growing demand for industry oversight and which state is seeing a surprise pushback against data center construction.

items.title: Wall Street Is Sleeping on These 3 Ultra-High-Yield Dividend Stocks
items.summary: Three famous dividend names trade well below their five-year highs while their CEOs publicly draw lines in the sand around the payout. Whether the cash flow actually backs that confidence is a different question entirely.

items.title: PBR Q2 Earnings Beat on Record Output, but Can the Gains Persist?
items.summary: Petrobras' Q2 earnings beat rode record production, higher exports and Brent prices, but softer crude could test how much of the gains can persist.

items.title: 3 Rock Solid Dividend That Pay You Every Month
items.summary: Three blue-chip dividend stocks, each on a different quarterly payment schedule, can fill every month of the year with income, but each one carries a distinct risk that could derail the whole ladder.

items.title: Why ExxonMobil's Financial Strength Matters for Investors
items.summary: XOM's low debt load and balance sheet provide flexibility when oil and gas prices fall, supporting operations, acquisitions and shareholder rewards.

items.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks with Competitive Advantages and 1 That Underwhelm
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.

items.title: When Inflation Is Sticky, 5 Dividend Aristocrats Are the Stocks to Own Now and Forever
items.summary: Sticky inflation is quietly rewarding a specific group of stocks with decades of uninterrupted dividend growth, and Wall Street's top analysts say five of them are built to profit no matter how long rising prices persist.

items.title: What Does Chevron (CVX) Want From Its Nuclear Fusion Push?
items.summary: Chevron (NYSE:CVX) is expanding its energy portfolio with new investments in nuclear fusion technology as part of Big Oil's broader push toward commercial fusion power. The company is backing multiple fusion approaches that aim to create future low carbon baseload power and potential revenue streams beyond oil and gas.
